newsitem.title: USA: Tokheim files report on Sofitam acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Tokheim files report on Sofitam acquisition.

text.p: Tokheim Corp said Wednesday it filed a Form 8K report covering its September 6 acquisition of the petroleum dispenser business of Sofitam S.A. of Paris, France.
The purchase price of the acquisition, including equity and repayment of debt of the acquired business, was about $108 million.
As previously disclosed, the transaction was financed by the private placement of $100 million subordinated notes due 2006 and use of part of an $80 million bank credit facility.

On a combined pro forma basis, the combined companies had operating income for the year ended November 30, 1995 of $17.5 million before a Sofitam pre-tax special charge of $4.3 million involving non-cash adjustments for changes in accounting for research and development and amortization of goodwill.
